description: COMMUNICATION (the timeless human sense): language, message, meaning, signal, rhetoric, dialogue, expression. Taught honestly — communication is genuinely DIFFUSE (also a technical networking sense: protocol, packet, bandwidth) — and NOT forced across: left to the edge-measure, it stays split and resolves universal via the anchor fallback (reported, not registered as an anchor).

microtheory.name: communication
microtheory.definition: The timeless act of conveying meaning between minds: language and message, sign and symbol, sender and receiver, rhetoric and dialogue, expression and its reception. A universal human faculty Cornelius Vane's rhetorical age prized.

concepts.name: language
concepts.definition: A systematic means of communication by signs, sounds or gestures.

concepts.name: message
concepts.definition: The content conveyed from a sender to a receiver.

concepts.name: meaning
concepts.definition: The sense or significance a sign or utterance carries.

concepts.name: signal
concepts.definition: A carrier that conveys information from source to destination.

concepts.name: rhetoric
concepts.definition: The classical art of persuasive speech and writing.

concepts.name: dialogue
concepts.definition: An exchange of utterances between two or more participants.

concepts.name: expression
concepts.definition: The outward conveyance of thought or feeling.

concepts.name: sign
concepts.definition: Something that stands for something else to an interpreter.

concepts.name: symbol
concepts.definition: A sign whose relation to its object is by convention.

concepts.name: medium
concepts.definition: The channel through which a message is conveyed.

concepts.name: sender
concepts.definition: The originator who encodes and transmits a message.

concepts.name: receiver
concepts.definition: The party who receives and decodes a message.

concepts.name: feedback
concepts.definition: The receiver's response that informs the sender.

concepts.name: context
concepts.definition: The circumstances that shape a message's meaning.

concepts.name: discourse
concepts.definition: Extended, structured communication in speech or writing.

concepts.name: semantics
concepts.definition: The study of meaning in language and signs.
